question: Which of the following carry/carries digested and absorbed fat from the intestine?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lymph.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• Lymph is actually a **fluid which is ** present in the **lymphatic** system**.**
 
• **Lymph has no colour and it ** contain specialized lymphocytes, which control the immune responses of the body.
 
• **Lymph** also carry nutrients, hormones, etc.
 
• lymph can absorb fat in the intestinal villi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plasma**

 
 
• **T****he liquid portion of blood is called Plasma**. 
 
• About 55% of our blood is plasma.
 
• The remaining 45% are red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets which are suspended in the plasma.
 
 
 
• **Platelets**
 
 
• The major function of Platelets is to **prevent and stop bleeding**.
 
• When a blood vessel is damaged, then the body sends signals to platelets this cause them to travel to the injured area.
 
• Once the platelets arrive at the site, they clump together to form a clot that helps stop bleeding.
 
 
 
• **Veins**
 
 
• The first purpose of vein is to **collect oxygen-poor blood throughout your body and carry it back to your heart**.
 
• The another purpose is to carry oxygen-rich blood from your lungs to your heart.
